patterns.note: The site predominantly uses a dark mode layout with full-width sections, creating a high-contrast visual experience.
A high-contrast color scheme is used, pairing a deep black background with white text, punctuated by a single vibrant purple for accents and calls to action.

A single, modern sans-serif typeface is used across the site, with significant variations in size and weight to establish a clear typographic hierarchy, from oversized hero headings to smaller body text.
The header navigation bar transforms upon scroll, changing from a transparent overlay to a sticky bar with a solid dark background and an added purple branding element at the top.

The hero section features a large background image that scrolls at a different rate than the foreground text, eventually revealing a solid black background behind the text as the image scrolls out of view.

technique_notes: A sticky header navigation bar that initially appears transparent over the hero, then transitions to a solid background with an added branding element (purple bar) and a slight height reduction after the user scrolls past the hero section.

The hero section features a large background image that scrolls at a different rate than the foreground text, creating a subtle parallax effect, eventually revealing a solid background behind the text as the image scrolls completely out of view.

Content sections below the hero appear to reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement, likely utilizing detected animation tech like Lottie for dynamic elements and video for hero backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, regular-weight body text for readability.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep black background combined with a single, vibrant purple accent creates a sophisticated and bold aesthetic. The dynamic hero section, where the background image scrolls away to reveal a solid black behind the main text, is a memorable and elegant transition.
